lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are organized into approximately five visible vertical columns posterior to the gill region, showing a regular spacing pattern across the mid-lateral field.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical linear segments of elevated luminance intersect with the circular spots, forming a coordinate-like grid across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel linear features extend horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp intensity transition from high-luminance upper edges to shadowed lower boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: A unique U-shaped high-luminance line pattern is present on the central flank, positioned vertically above the pectoral fin insertion point.
